description: This file contains implementations of variable tracking classes for list-like data structures in Dynamo, including list, tuple, range, torch.Size, collections.deque, and their subclasses, with methods for sequence operations, proxies, and code reconstruction.

classes.name: BaseListVariable
classes.description: Base class for list-like variable tracking, providing common sequence operations, proxies, and method dispatch.

classes.name: RangeVariable
classes.description: Variable class representing Python range objects with support for indexing, slicing, and comparison.

classes.name: CommonListMethodsVariable
classes.description: Mixin class implementing common list methods like append, extend, insert, pop, clear, sort, etc.

classes.name: ListVariable
classes.description: Variable class for Python list objects, supporting sequence operations, method calls, and reconstruction.

classes.name: DequeVariable
classes.description: Variable class for collections.deque, supporting sequence operations and deque-specific methods.

classes.name: TupleVariable
classes.description: Variable class for Python tuple objects, supporting sequence operations and hashing.

classes.name: SizeVariable
classes.description: Variable class for torch.Size objects, with special proxy handling and size operations.

classes.name: NamedTupleVariable
classes.description: Variable class for namedtuple and structseq types, supporting attribute access and dynamic attributes.

classes.name: SliceVariable
classes.description: Variable class representing slice objects with support for conversion to Python slice and code reconstruction.

classes.name: ListIteratorVariable
classes.description: Iterator class for list objects, supporting iteration and sequence unpacking.

classes.name: RangeIteratorVariable
classes.description: Iterator class for range objects, supporting iteration, next, and attribute access.

methods.name: cls_for_instance
methods.description: Returns the class for an instance based on its type.

methods.name: cls_for
methods.description: Returns the class for a given object type.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a new instance with modified items.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the Python constant value of the variable.

methods.name: debug_repr_helper
methods.description: Helper for generating debug string representations.

methods.name: as_python_constant
methods.description: Converts the variable to a Python constant.

methods.name: as_proxy
methods.description: Converts the variable to a FX proxy or similar.

methods.name: getitem_const
methods.description: Handles __getitem__ with constant index or slice.

methods.name: unpack_var_sequence
methods.description: Unpacks the variable sequence into a list.

methods.name: call_tree_map_branch
methods.description: Applies a tree map function across list elements.

methods.name: call_method
methods.description: Dispatches method calls like __getitem__, append, extend, sort, etc.

methods.name: python_type
methods.description: Returns the Python type this variable represents.

methods.name: debug_repr
methods.description: Returns a string for debugging.

methods.name: reconstruct
methods.description: Reconstructs code for the variable.

methods.name: call_obj_hasattr
methods.description: Checks if object has attribute.

methods.name: is_python_hashable
methods.description: Indicates if the object is hashable.

methods.name: get_python_hash
methods.description: Computes the hash of the object.

methods.name: is_python_equal
methods.description: Checks equality with another object.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the start value of a range.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Returns the stop value of a range.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Returns the step value of a range.

methods.name: range_length
methods.description: Returns the length of the range.

methods.name: _get_slice_indices
methods.description: Calculates start, stop, step indices for slicing.

methods.name: apply_index
methods.description: Applies an index to the range.

methods.name: apply_slice
methods.description: Creates a new RangeVariable from a slice.

methods.name: as_python_constant
methods.description: Returns the range as a Python range object.

methods.name: getitem_const
methods.description: Handles __getitem__ for range with int or slice.

methods.name: as_proxy
methods.description: Converts range to a proxy.

methods.name: unpack_var_sequence
methods.description: Unpacks range into a list of variables.

methods.name: call_method
methods.description: Handles range-specific methods like __iter__, __len__, count, __getitem__, comparisons.

methods.name: var_getattr
methods.description: Gets attribute like start, stop, step.

methods.name: range_equals
methods.description: Checks if two ranges are equal.

methods.name: range_count
methods.description: Counts occurrences of a value in the range.

methods.name: next_variable
methods.description: Returns the next value in the range iterator.

methods.name: call_obj_hasattr
methods.description: Checks attribute existence for range iterator.
